novatienda.s.cliente-02-registro.title: Sign up
novatienda.s.cliente-02-registro.desc: Sign-up form with an optional personal or company ID, name, surnames, email and phone. Every field is validated as the user types (the phone, for instance, follows the 8888-8888 format). The password must meet a minimum length and strength. New users must accept the terms and privacy policy, and that acceptance is recorded.
novatienda.s.cliente-03-recuperar-contra: Customers enter their email and receive instructions to choose a new password. The emailed link is single-use and expires, and the reply is the same whether or not the account exists, so it never reveals who is registered. Changing the password signs out any previous sessions.
novatienda.s.cliente-04-inicio.title: Home
novatienda.s.cliente-04-inicio.desc: A landing page that works like a shop window: a clear message, a featured product with its price in colones and an add-to-cart button, and two more products beside it. Below it, the stores with their opening hours and a best-sellers carousel. Visitors see what is sold, what it costs and where to pick it up on one screen.
novatienda.s.cliente-04-inicio.alt: Store home page with a featured product.
novatienda.s.cliente-05-tienda.title: Store
novatienda.s.cliente-05-tienda.desc: A catalog organized for quick discovery: a category bar with arrows and dropdown subcategories, a name search and round category shortcuts. Carousels for promotions, best sellers and new arrivals, each with its own “See all” button. Every card shows a favorites heart, the price and a one-tap add to cart.
novatienda.s.cliente-05-tienda.alt: Store catalog with categories and carousels.
novatienda.s.cliente-06-tienda-todos-los: The full catalog with combinable filters by category, brand and more, sorted by newest. It shows how many products match and clears the filters in one click. Pagination lets visitors choose how many products to see per page. On phones, the filters open in a separate panel.
novatienda.s.cliente-07-contacto.title: Contact
novatienda.s.cliente-07-contacto.desc: A direct line to the business: customers write their name, email and message, and the platform opens WhatsApp with everything pre-filled, so there is no inbox to monitor. It includes social links and one card per store with address, hours, phone and “How to get there”. A frequently-asked-questions section closes the page.
novatienda.s.cliente-07-contacto.alt: Contact page with form and store locations.
novatienda.s.cliente-08-mi-cuenta.title: My account
novatienda.s.cliente-08-mi-cuenta.desc: The customer's personal area, split into sections: my details, delivery address, orders, reviews and security. They can update their information with per-field validation, follow the status of their orders. Under Security they turn on two-step verification with an authenticator app.
novatienda.s.cliente-08-mi-cuenta.alt: My account area with the customer's personal details.
novatienda.s.cliente-09-favoritos.title: Favorites
novatienda.s.cliente-09-favoritos.desc: The list of products the customer marked with a heart, ready to resume shopping. Each card shows the image, name and price, and lets the customer remove the product or open its page. It is a shortcut for shoppers who compare several options before deciding.
novatienda.s.cliente-10-carrito.title: Cart
novatienda.s.cliente-10-carrito.desc: Customers review what they are about to buy: image, color, editable quantity, price and weight of each product. A summary computes the subtotal, total weight and an estimated shipping cost based on weight, with the choice of home delivery or free in-store pickup. It closes with the total and the proceed-to-payment button.
novatienda.s.cliente-10-carrito.alt: Shopping cart with summary and delivery method.
novatienda.s.cliente-11-producto.title: Product
novatienda.s.cliente-11-producto.desc: Everything a buyer needs to decide: a gallery of photos and videos, price in colones, warranty, color variants and available units. A panel shows the stock level at each store, so buyers know where to pick up. It adds buy-now, add to cart or favorites, ask on WhatsApp, the technical sheet and reviews.
novatienda.s.cliente-11-producto.alt: Product page with gallery, price and per-store availability.
novatienda.s.cliente-12-checkout.title: Checkout
novatienda.s.cliente-12-checkout.desc: Order summary and confirmation on a single page: contact details, delivery method, an address with cascading province, canton and district, and loyalty points that can be redeemed as a discount. For store pickup, customers choose a store that has the whole order. Payment is completed on the secure Onvopay gateway; the shop never sees or stores card data.
novatienda.s.cliente-12-checkout.alt: Checkout screen with delivery details and order summary.
novatienda.s.negocio-01-dashboard.title: Dashboard
novatienda.s.negocio-01-dashboard.desc: The business at a glance: sales, orders, average ticket, new customers, profit, margin, best-selling product and low-stock products, each compared with the previous period. Sales and profit charts over time and a monthly goal. It filters by date range and by store, and exports to PDF.
novatienda.s.negocio-01-dashboard.alt: Dashboard with KPIs and sales charts.
novatienda.s.negocio-02-pedidos.title: Orders
novatienda.s.negocio-02-pedidos.desc: Every order in a table with search and filters by status, shipping method and store. From the detail view, the team changes the status (processing, shipped, delivered), records the postal tracking number and proof of delivery, and can reassign the order to another store. Every change is audited and notifies the customer.
novatienda.s.negocio-03-productos.title: Products
novatienda.s.negocio-03-productos.desc: The complete catalog with image, price, cost, stock, weight and status, plus filters by category, status, brand and date. When creating or editing a product, the team uploads photos, up to three videos, color and size variants, warranty and each store's stock. It includes bulk selection and access to the tax data for e-invoicing.
novatienda.s.negocio-04-inventario.title: Inventory
novatienda.s.negocio-04-inventario.desc: The stock of every variant in every store, one column per store plus the total. Quantities below the minimum are highlighted with an alert, and a filter shows only what needs restocking. From here, units are transferred between stores, and each transfer is kept in a history showing who made it.
novatienda.s.negocio-05-tiendas.title: Stores
novatienda.s.negocio-05-tiendas.desc: Store management: location, phone, opening hours, units in inventory, open orders and each store's monthly sales goal. Stores can be created, edited, activated and deactivated; the platform blocks deactivating one that has orders in progress. This data automatically feeds the footer, the contact page and the checkout.
novatienda.s.negocio-06-reportes.title: Reports
novatienda.s.negocio-06-reportes.desc: Reports on sales and revenue, profit, inventory, customers, promotions and reviews. Each one offers sub-reports (by product, category, brand, area or customer), a date-range and store filter, and Excel and PDF export. The figures come from the same data as the dashboard, so they always match.
novatienda.s.negocio-06-reportes.alt: Sales report with filters and export.
novatienda.s.negocio-07-facturacion.desc: The electronic tax documents of each sale, as required by Costa Rica's tax authority: receipts, invoices and credit notes with their status, sequence number, total and store. A summary counts those in progress, accepted, with problems or discarded. A failed submission can be retried and the files downloaded. Invoicing is issued automatically once the payment is confirmed.
novatienda.s.negocio-08-configuracion.de: The business details the team can change without technical help: social networks, contact phone and email, the company's legal data and the monthly sales goal. Every field is validated (the WhatsApp number, for instance), and whatever is saved is reflected on the public site, in the footer and in the legal texts.
novatienda.s.negocio-09-clientes.title: Customers
novatienda.s.negocio-09-clientes.desc: The list of registered customers and their purchase activity: number of orders, total spent and loyalty points earned. It is searchable by name or email and sortable, for example from highest to lowest spend, to spot the best customers. Each row opens a detail view with the customer's history.
novatienda.s.negocio-10-usuarios.title: Users
novatienda.s.negocio-10-usuarios.desc: Staff accounts with their role, the stores they can see, their two-step verification status and whether they are active. Each person sees and edits only what belongs to their own stores. The platform stops anyone from changing accounts with more privileges than their own or granting themselves more permissions than they hold.
novatienda.s.negocio-11-roles.title: Roles & permissions
novatienda.s.negocio-11-roles.desc: The panel's roles, with how many people hold each one. For every role you define, module by module, what it can do: view, create, edit or delete. A store manager can run their orders and inventory without reaching the settings. System roles are protected, and a role that still has users cannot be deleted by mistake.
novatienda.s.negocio-12-auditoria.title: Audit log
novatienda.s.negocio-12-auditoria.desc: The log of everything that happens: who did what, in which module, on which store and when. It records changes to the catalog, orders, stock, users and payments, plus sign-ins. It filters by module, action, user, store and dates, and “View detail” shows exactly which value changed. The log cannot be edited from the panel.
novatienda.s.negocio-13-notificaciones.d: The panel's bell alerts the team to whatever needs attention: new orders, low-stock products and reassigned orders. Each alert reaches only the right people, based on their store and permissions. They can be marked as read one by one or all at once, and the counter shows how many are still pending.
